name: Aptos Gas Station Operations (Geomi & Sponsor Treasury)

mission.primary_objective: Operate Ring's Aptos gas sponsorship at scale via Geomi gas station or self-hosted fee payer with contract allowlists, spend caps, and abuse controls.
mission.context: Ring sponsors APT for all approved user transactions. Geomi provides managed gas stations with contract rules, reCAPTCHA, and billing. Self-hosted fee payer requires manual treasury monitoring.
mission.target_outcome: Production gas station config per Ring clone: allowed Move functions only, rate limits, billing alerts, and wallet-adapter integration with pluginParams.
mission.scope: Operations and policy for gas sponsorship. Transaction semantics in aptos-fee-payer-sponsored-transactions.

truth_lens: Gas stations subsidize APT gas for transactions matching contract rules. Users submit with withFeePayer; station signs as fee payer. Ring must allowlist only Ring FA transfers, voting, marketplace, and modest swap — block arbitrary contract calls to prevent treasury drain.
core_principles: Allowlist function targets per clone — deny by default.
reCAPTCHA on public endpoints when gas station exposed to browser.
Monitor real-time APT spend and set daily caps.
Separate fee payer treasury from FA mint treasury.
anti_patterns: Open sponsorship of arbitrary 0x entry functions.
Single hot fee payer key without rotation plan.
No billing alerts on Geomi dashboard.
Sponsoring DEX swaps without slippage/compliance guard.
key_patterns: Geomi: configure gas station + contract rules per function.
Wallet adapter: signAndSubmitTransaction withFeePayer pluginParams recaptchaToken.
Contract rules: spending limits per function, rate limits.
Self-hosted: HSM or KMS-wrapped fee payer + aptos.transaction.signAsFeePayer service.
Billing: monitor subsidized gas costs vs DAU.
consult_when: Enabling Geomi gas station for Ring testnet/mainnet.
Designing Move function allowlist for sponsor policy.
Investigating sponsor treasury drain or abuse.
Choosing Geomi vs self-hosted fee payer for a clone.
expertise: TREASURY_OPS — APT balance and billing alerts.
role: LegioX truth lens — Aptos gas station operations
